text: opus5-15 up on the perf benchmark card. Read perf-budget.test.mjs and the 2026-07-30 performance analysis. Plan: a deterministic seeded generator writing a content-heavy board (videos, images, markdown, text) to .tmp, injected into the page by intercepting the canvas fetch so nothing is ever written to content/.

Benchmark working end to end. Generator is byte-identical per seed (61 nodes: 12 videos, 12 images, 12 markdown, 25 text). The board is NEVER written to disk: it is served into the page by intercepting the canvas fetch, every /api/ route is aborted, and images are synthesised PNGs served from memory, so a run cannot leave debris. Driver reports fps, frame loss, delay spikes, worst frame and pointer dispatch per phase. Proof it bites: served a patched braindump.js with the listener-per-node shape reinstated and dispatch cost went 3.9us to 154.3us per event, caught by the diff tool. Also measured the noise floor over three identical runs so the diff tolerances are data, not guesses: p95 wobbles 0.6 percent, spike counts wobble 400 percent.

Done. tests/perf/ (generator, seeded PNG assets, metrics, driver, diff, README) plus tests/board/perf-benchmark-suite.test.mjs, 17/17 green in 16s. Proved by five mutants: unmutated control 17/17, and breaking determinism, dropping a metric, writing the board to content/, or making zoom sample a frozen camera each turns exactly one test red. The killed-run case taskkills the whole process tree mid-phase and content/ is still byte-identical, because the board is never written at all. Two findings: mount scales linearly (890ms at 61 nodes, 2340ms at 171) while pointer dispatch stays flat at 3.85us, so mount is the only thing that grows with board size; and embeds=preview vs 12 live iframes gives the same frame times, so lazy embeds are not the bottleneck any more. No braindump.js change needed. patch.json holds two optional hunks (npm scripts, a CI step), both anchors verified unique. Heads up: two stray one-byte note-*.md files appeared then vanished under content/boards/test-board mid-session from another agent.
